G'day everyone, my name is [name]. Im 34m from the north side.

Im not very good at talking about myself but my interests are Xbox gaming, Symphonic Metal, Science, Trains, Planes and Automobiles.

I am diagnosed ASD + ADHD + others.

I have been looking for an autistic social group for ages now so really excited to be here and meet all of you.

I've never used discord before so sorry if I am a bit unsure of what buttons to press 😅
